mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is currently 71 degrees with moderate rain as we look toward conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School.

The big news today is the upcoming Verona Fire Department Open House on September 19. You can stop by 101 Lincoln Street between 10 am and 2 pm to tour the station, meet local firefighters, and participate in important fire safety demonstrations.

We have a busy day in Verona today with the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Nights at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.

Regarding the weekly report, the Verona Police Department announced that on Sunday, August 30, they arrested a 34-year-old staff member from the Verona Area School District on charges of sexual assault of a child.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Please note that the store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
